input.quote: 6.15 No Other Compensation. Each Party hereby agrees that the terms of this Agreement fully define all consideration, compensation and benefits, monetary or otherwise, to be paid, granted or delivered by one Party to the other Party in connection with the transactions contemplated herein.
input.rationale: We searched the whole agreement for MFN and MFN-equivalent mechanics ("most favoured/favored nation", "no less favorable", "more favorable", "at least as favorable", "comparable terms", price parity, right-to-match/first negotiation) and reviewed the economic provisions in Article 6 (upfront, milestones, royalties and the Section 6.5.3 reduction mechanics, including the redacted [***] payment terms). No provision requires AbbVie (Customer) to extend to Harpoon (Vendor) terms no less favourable than those given to any Third Party, or to match a Third Party's terms; the Article 6 consideration is fixed and Section 6.15 confirms the Agreement fully defines all consideration passing between the Parties. The Section 6.5.3(b) Third Party licence mechanic operates in our favour (a royalty deduction), not as a parity obligation. This meets the preferred position — no MFN obligation burdening Customer — so no redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
